spec: OLS log(co2_cems) ~ log(co2_ghgrp) with HC1 robust SE

sample.dropped: 6 refinery facility-years (consistent with the LME sample)

headline: For the U.S. power-sector cohort (n=7,627 facility-years, 575 facilities, 48 parents), CEMS continuous-stack measurements and GHGRP self-reports show high agreement at the facility-year level (R² = 0.977; OLS slope 0.9929 with 95% CI [0.9870, 0.9987]; intercept +0.0800 not statistically distinguishable from 0). The median CEMS/GHGRP ratio is 0.9964. Per-parent deviations are statistically detectable due to large sample sizes but bounded (largest systematic deviation = 21.0%; most parents <10%). This contrasts sharply with the broader S&P 500 where Cohen, Rouen & Sachdeva (2026) documented a 74% restatement rate, suggesting self-reports approach measurement-grade reliability in sectors with continuous monitoring infrastructure.
